title:
一、(一) 英譯中：請將下列英文段落翻譯成中文。（15 分）
Under the authority granted by the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA), as amended, a Customs and Boarder Protection (CBP) officer may question, under oath, any person coming into the country to determine his or her admissibility. In addition, an inspector has authority to search without warrant the person and effects of any person seeking admission.
answer: 依《移民與國籍法》（INA）及其修正條文所授予的權限，海關及邊境保護局（CBP）官員得在宣誓後訊問任何入境人士，以判定其是否准予入境。此外，檢查員有權對尋求入境者的人身與隨身物品進行無令狀搜索。
hint:
句構拆解
  • Under the authority granted by the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA), as amended,：介系詞片語置句首表依據；granted by... 是過去分詞修飾 authority；as amended＝「及其修正條文」。
  • a Customs and Border Protection (CBP) officer may question, under oath, any person coming into the country：主幹（CBP 官員得訊問任何入境者）；under oath 插入語，表「在宣誓後」；coming into the country 是現在分詞修飾 person。
  • to determine his or her admissibility：不定詞表目的（判定是否准予入境）。
  • an inspector has authority to search without warrant the person and effects of any person seeking admission：search 的受詞是 the person and effects；without warrant＝無令狀；seeking admission 是現在分詞修飾 person。
關鍵詞
  • under the authority granted by 依……授予之權限
  • under oath 宣誓後、具結
  • admissibility 准予入境（admissible 可入境的）
  • without warrant 無令狀（warrant＝搜索令）
  • effects 隨身物品、財物（複數名詞）
翻譯技巧
  • 英文的長介系詞片語開頭，中文可保留「依……所授予之權限」的句式，但要把 as amended 併入「及其修正條文」。
  • under oath 不要直譯「在誓言之下」，譯「宣誓後」或「具結後」較自然。
  • search without warrant the person and effects：中文語序宜調整為「對……的人身與隨身物品進行無令狀搜索」。
  • admissibility 是法律術語，譯「是否准予入境」比「可接受性」精確。

title:
一、(二) 中譯英：請將下列中文段落翻譯成英文。（15 分）
今天連假第一天，桃園機場出入境、加上轉機旅客就超過十萬人次排隊人潮。有人形容就像看不到盡頭，得提前幾個小時、提早報到！搭機出國，搭船到離島的旅客也不少，前往綠島遊玩的遊客，第一班客輪就載滿約 300 人。
answer: Today is the first day of the long weekend, and more than 100,000 arriving, departing, and transit passengers have formed long queues at Taoyuan Airport. Some described the lines as seemingly endless and said they had to check in several hours early. Besides those flying abroad, many travelers were taking ferries to offshore islands; the first ferry to Green Island was packed with about 300 tourists.
hint:
句構策略
  • 原文三句，英文也建議三句對應：①連假首日＋桃機人潮；②有人形容排隊看不到盡頭、要提早報到；③搭機／搭船的分流說明。
  • 「出入境、加上轉機旅客就超過十萬人次」→ 用 arriving, departing, and transit passengers 三類並列，動詞用 have formed long queues。
  • 「有人形容就像看不到盡頭」→ Some described the lines as seemingly endless.
  • 「得提前幾個小時、提早報到」→ said they had to check in several hours early（注意時態用過去式，因是受訪者的說法）。
  • 「第一班客輪就載滿約 300 人」→ the first ferry to Green Island was packed with about 300 tourists.
關鍵詞
  • 連假 long weekend／holiday weekend
  • 轉機旅客 transit passengers
  • 排隊人潮 long queues／queues of people
  • 報到 check in；客輪 ferry
  • 離島 offshore islands；綠島 Green Island
  • 載滿 be packed with／carry a full load of
易錯點
  • 「十萬人次」不要譯成 100,000 people times——英文用 more than 100,000 passenger trips 或直接說 more than 100,000 passengers。
  • 「看不到盡頭」直譯 can't see the end 不道地，用 seemingly endless。
  • 「搭機出國，搭船到離島的旅客也不少」可用 Besides those flying abroad, many travelers were taking ferries... 避免兩個句子都用 There were...。

title:
二、英文作文：（20 分）
Taiwan has been ranked as the fourth-happiest country in Asia and 27th in the world by the Ranking Royals website. The ranking is based on six criteria, including healthy life expectancy, GDP per capita, social support, freedom to make your own decisions in life, absence of business and government corruption, and giving to charity. Write an essay of about 250~300 words to describe your reactions to this news.
answer:
The news that Taiwan ranks fourth-happiest in Asia and 27th worldwide, according to Ranking Royals, will probably produce two reactions: quiet pride and healthy skepticism.

The pride is understandable. The six criteria—healthy life expectancy, GDP per capita, social support, freedom to make life decisions, absence of corruption, and charitable giving—describe something real. Taiwan's national health insurance, dense family networks, vibrant civic life, and comparatively clean bureaucracy are genuine achievements, especially for a small island with limited resources and a difficult diplomatic position. That a country often excluded from international rankings performs well on well-being is worth celebrating.

Yet I would read the ranking cautiously. Happiness indices compress very different lives into a single number. Taiwan also has high housing prices, long working hours, a widening income gap, and migrant workers whose rights remain fragile; none of these appear in the six criteria. GDP per capita says little about distribution, and the freedom to make one's own decisions means different things to a young graduate in Taipei and a farmer in Yunlin. A country can be ranked happy while many of its people are exhausted.

Still, rankings matter because they start conversations. If the result encourages the government to protect what works—health care, social trust, safety—while addressing what the index cannot see, the number will have done its job. For me, the lesson is neither blind pride nor dismissal: Taiwan is a good place to live, and it can become better.
hint:
審題
  • 題目要的是你的反應（reactions），不是介紹排名或翻譯新聞。
  • 建議立場：既肯定又保留——肯定排名反映的優點，也指出指標看不到的問題。
  • 字數：250–300 字（務必遵守）。
四段架構
  • 第一段（引言）：點出新聞＋預告兩種反應（quiet pride and healthy skepticism），作為全文主軸。
  • 第二段（肯定）：對應六項指標——健保、家庭支持、公民社會、相對廉潔的官僚體系；並強調「被國際排名排除的國家也能表現良好」。
  • 第三段（保留）：指出指標的盲點——高房價、長工時、所得差距、移工權益；GDP 看不出分配；「自由」對不同人有不同感受。
  • 第四段（結論）：排名的價值在於開啟討論；政府應保護強項、補足盲點；以「Taiwan is a good place to live, and it can become better.」收尾。
關鍵詞彙
  • healthy life expectancy 健康餘命；GDP per capita 人均 GDP
  • social support 社會支持；absence of corruption 無貪腐
  • national health insurance 全民健保；civic life 公民生活
  • housing prices 房價；income gap 所得差距；working hours 工時
  • migrant workers 移工；distribution 分配
  • happiness index 幸福指數；well-being 福祉
加分句型
  • will probably produce two reactions: quiet pride and healthy skepticism.（破題有力）
  • compress very different lives into a single number（批判指標的生動動詞）
  • neither blind pride nor dismissal（結論的對稱結構）
  • A country can be ranked happy while many of its people are exhausted.（while 對比）
評分重點
  • 結構：四段、每段一個中心句。
  • 內容：要回應六項指標，不能只泛泛說「台灣很好」。
  • 用字：避免 good/bad，多用具體名詞（distribution, index, bureaucracy）。
  • 文法：讓步與對比（while, yet, neither...nor）運用正確。

title: The way our eyes and brain handle information has become ______. Thanks to television, film and computers, our ability to process images is faster.
hint:
1. The way our eyes and brain handle information has become sophisticated. Thanks to television, film and computers, our ability to process images is faster.
（我們眼睛與大腦處理資訊的方式已變得精密複雜。拜電視、電影與電腦之賜，我們處理影像的能力更快了。）
  • 考點：sophisticated＝精密的、複雜的、成熟的（此處指處理機制變得更精密）。
  • 線索：後句說「處理影像的能力更快」→ 表示機制變得「更精密」。
  • 其他選項：monotonous 單調的；subsequent 隨後的；vulnerable 脆弱的。
  • 例句：Modern cameras use sophisticated sensors.（現代相機使用精密感測器。）
撇步
  • 「變得精密、複雜」→ sophisticated（反義：simple）。

title: When we don't believe we have the resources or abilities to cope with a certain problem or stimuli, we create ______ behaviors to deny or avoid it.
hint:
2. When we don't believe we have the resources or abilities to cope with a certain problem or stimuli, we create adaptive behaviors to deny or avoid it.
（當我們不相信自己有資源或能力應付某個問題或刺激時，就會產生否認或逃避的調適行為。）
  • 考點：adaptive behavior＝調適行為（為了適應環境而產生的行為）。
  • 線索：cope with（應付）＋deny or avoid it（否認或逃避）→ 這是心理上的「調適」。
  • 其他選項：rigid 僵化的；indiscrete 不審慎的（正確拼法 indiscreet）；insulated 隔絕的。
  • 例句：Children develop adaptive behaviors to cope with stress.（兒童會發展出調適行為來因應壓力。）
撇步
  • cope with（因應）→ adaptive（調適的）。

title: Being a professional artist, Lisa mostly makes drawings, paintings, and sculptures, and ______ she is invited to make fashion illustrations.
hint:
3. Being a professional artist, Lisa mostly makes drawings, paintings, and sculptures, and occasionally she is invited to make fashion illustrations.
（身為專業藝術家，麗莎主要創作素描、繪畫與雕塑，偶爾也會受邀繪製時尚插畫。）
  • 考點：occasionally＝偶爾；與 mostly（主要）形成頻率對比。
  • 句構：Being a professional artist 是分詞構句表身分；mostly ↔ occasionally 對比。
  • 其他選項：aggressively 積極地；evidently 明顯地；intimately 親密地。
  • 例句：She occasionally writes for a magazine.（她偶爾為雜誌寫稿。）
撇步
  • mostly（主要）的反面是 occasionally（偶爾）。

title: Anita's 2-year gym membership is no longer ______; she is thinking about getting a lifelong membership offered by a newly opened gym near her place.
hint:
4. Anita's 2-year gym membership is no longer valid; she is thinking about getting a lifelong membership offered by a newly opened gym near her place.
（安妮塔的兩年健身房會員資格已失效；她正考慮辦一張住家附近新開健身房提供的終身會員。）
  • 考點：valid＝有效的（票券、證件、會員資格）；no longer valid＝已失效。
  • 線索：2-year membership（兩年期）＋no longer → 期限已過、失效。
  • 其他選項：cordial 熱誠的；diverse 多樣的；liable 有責任的。
  • 例句：Your ticket is valid for one month.（你的票有效期限一個月。）
撇步
  • 票券、會員、護照「有效」→ valid；「失效」→ expire。

title: During their one-week trip to Yushan National Park, the Lins visited many ______ spots and truly enjoyed the breathtaking views in the mountains.
hint:
5. During their one-week trip to Yushan National Park, the Lins visited many scenic spots and truly enjoyed the breathtaking views in the mountains.
（在林家為期一週的玉山國家公園之行中，他們造訪了許多風景優美的景點，盡情欣賞山中令人屏息的美景。）
  • 考點：scenic spot＝風景名勝（固定搭配）。
  • 線索：Yushan National Park（玉山國家公園）＋breathtaking views（令人屏息的美景）。
  • 其他選項：chaotic 混乱的；drastic 激烈的；hectic 忙碌的。
  • 例句：We drove along the scenic coast.（我們沿著風景優美的海岸開車。）
撇步
  • 景點、路線、公路「風景優美」→ scenic。

title: Although Irene failed to make the national swimming team this year, she refused to live her life ______ like a loser; instead she practiced even harder to try again next year.
hint:
6. Although Irene failed to make the national swimming team this year, she refused to live her life pathetically like a loser; instead she practiced even harder to try again next year.
（雖然艾琳今年未能入選國家游泳隊，她拒絕像個失敗者一樣可悲地過日子；反而更加努力練習，準備明年再試。）
  • 考點：pathetically＝可悲地、可憐地（pathetic 可悲的）。
  • 線索：like a loser（像個失敗者）→ 修飾語必帶負面意味。
  • 其他選項：confidentially 機密地；legitimately 合法地；rigorously 嚴格地。
  • 例句：He smiled pathetically and walked away.（他笑得很可悲，然後走開。）
撇步
  • loser（失敗者）→ pathetically（可悲地）。

title: Those board members who looked at Amanda's new business idea ______ and challenged it harshly would never expect that the idea later turned out to be a huge success.
hint:
7. Those board members who looked at Amanda's new business idea quizzically and challenged it harshly would never expect that the idea later turned out to be a huge success.
（那些帶著質疑眼光審視艾曼達新事業構想、並嚴厲質疑的董事，絕對想不到這個構想後來大為成功。）
  • 考點：quizzically＝帶著疑惑地、質疑地（quiz＝盤問）。
  • 線索：challenged it harshly（嚴厲質疑）→ 看的時候是「存疑的」。
  • 其他選項：leniently 寬容地（反義）；pervasively 普遍地；susceptibly 易受影響地。
  • 例句：She looked at him quizzically.（她帶著疑惑看他。）
撇步
  • 「質疑＋嚴厲挑戰」→ quizzically；注意與 leniently（寬容）相反。

title: After the old emperor's death, the empire was ______ into several small states.
hint:
8. After the old emperor's death, the empire was disintegrated into several small states.
（老皇帝死後，帝國分裂成幾個小國。）
  • 考點：disintegrate＝解體、分裂（dis- 分離 + integrate 整合）。
  • 線索：the empire（帝國）＋into several small states（分成幾個小國）。
  • 其他選項：dismount 下馬；differentiate 區分；diverge 分岔（道路、意見）。
  • 例句：The country disintegrated into civil war.（那個國家陷入內戰而解體。）
撇步
  • 國家、帝國、組織「解體」→ disintegrate（近義：break up）。

title: He despised Pitt, ______ the similar views they both held.
hint:
9. He despised Pitt, notwithstanding the similar views they both held.
（儘管兩人觀點相似，他仍鄙視皮特。）
  • 考點：notwithstanding＝儘管（＝despite／in spite of），可置於名詞前後。
  • 線索：despised（鄙視）與 similar views（觀點相似）形成反差 → 需要「儘管」。
  • 其他選項：respecting 關於（介系詞）；honoring 尊崇；supposing 假設。
  • 例句：Notwithstanding the risks, they went ahead.（儘管有風險，他們仍繼續進行。）
撇步
  • 「雖然、儘管」→ notwithstanding／despite／in spite of，後面接名詞。

title: The way the government tackles the problem of civil war in this country is ______ because it has never ended in such a peaceful manner.
hint:
10. The way the government tackles the problem of civil war in this country is unprecedented because it has never ended in such a peaceful manner.
（該國政府處理內戰問題的方式前所未見，因為內戰從未以如此和平的方式結束。）
  • 考點：unprecedented＝前所未有的（un- + precedent + -ed）。
  • 線索：has never ended in such a peaceful manner（從未如此和平結束）→ 方式「前所未見」。
  • 其他選項：unanimous 全體一致的；unidentified 身分不明的；uprising 起義（名詞）。
  • 例句：The peace deal was an unprecedented step.（這項和平協議是前所未有的一步。）
撇步
  • never / first time / 破紀錄 → unprecedented。

title: The patients are asked to ______ for their medical expenses if they want to gain better medical service from their doctors.
hint:
11. The patients are asked to foot the bill for their medical expenses if they want to gain better medical service from their doctors.
（病人若想獲得醫師更好的醫療服務，被要求自行負擔醫療費用。）
  • 考點：foot the bill＝付帳、負擔費用（片語）。
  • 線索：medical expenses（醫療費用）→ 需「付費」。
  • 其他選項：spill the beans 洩漏秘密；miss the boat 錯失良機；hit the sack 上床睡覺。
  • 例句：Taxpayers will foot the bill for the new stadium.（納稅人將為新球場買單。）
撇步
  • 付錢的片語：foot the bill / pick up the tab。

title: Isaac still managed to complete the task he had been assigned to ______ its difficulty and time constraint.
hint:
12. Isaac still managed to complete the task he had been assigned to despite its difficulty and time constraint.
（儘管任務困難且時間緊迫，艾薩克仍設法完成交辦的工作。）
  • 考點：despite＝儘管（介系詞，後接名詞）；後面 its difficulty and time constraint 是名詞片語。
  • 線索：still managed to（仍然設法）＋difficulty（困難）→ 轉折關係。
  • 其他選項：since 自從、因為；instead 反而（副詞）；whether 是否。
  • 例句：She finished the race despite the injury.（儘管受傷，她仍完成比賽。）
撇步
  • 後面接名詞用 despite／in spite of；接子句用 although／though。

title: When donating a huge sum of money to charities, she prefers being an ______ donor and keeps her identity unknown to the public.
hint:
13. When donating a huge sum of money to charities, she prefers being an anonymous donor and keeps her identity unknown to the public.
（捐獻鉅款給慈善機構時，她偏好當匿名捐款人，不讓大眾知道她的身分。）
  • 考點：anonymous＝匿名的（anonymity 匿名）。
  • 線索：keeps her identity unknown（不讓身分曝光）→ 匿名。
  • 其他選項：aboriginal 原住民的；abundant 豐富的；ambiguous 模稜兩可的（易與 anonymous 混淆）。
  • 例句：An anonymous donor paid for the library.（一位匿名捐款人支付了圖書館的費用。）
撇步
  • 拼字陷阱：anonymous（匿名） vs ambiguous（模稜兩可）。

title: When they climb up to the peak of Mt. Everest, they can do nothing but ______ the stunning and breath-taking views out there.
hint:
14. When they climb up to the peak of Mt. Everest, they can do nothing but marvel at the stunning and breath-taking views out there.
（當他們登上聖母峰頂，除了讚嘆眼前令人屏息的美景，什麼也做不了。）
  • 考點：marvel at＝驚嘆、讚嘆（marvel 也可當名詞「奇蹟」）。
  • 句構：can do nothing but + 原形動詞（只能……）；but 後面接原形。
  • 其他選項：lay down 放下；pass off 冒充、逐漸消失；put across 表達、使人理解。
  • 例句：We marveled at the sunset.（我們讚嘆那場日落。）
撇步
  • do nothing but + 原形動詞；讚嘆美景用 marvel at。

title: John devoted himself to establishing the first hospital for the mentally ill in his country and was a notably generous ______ of the poor and outcast.
hint:
15. John devoted himself to establishing the first hospital for the mentally ill in his country and was a notably generous champion of the poor and outcast.
（約翰致力於在自己國家建立第一所精神科醫院，是窮人與被社會排斥者慷慨的捍衛者。）
  • 考點：champion（名詞）＝擁護者、捍衛者（動詞則是「倡導」）。
  • 線索：devoted himself to（致力於）＋the poor and outcast（窮人與被排斥者）→ 他是他們的「捍衛者」。
  • 其他選項：tranquilizer 鎮定劑；enchanter 施魔法者；prosecutor 檢察官。
  • 例句：She is a champion of women's rights.（她是女性權益的捍衛者。）
撇步
  • a champion of + 弱勢／理念＝某理念的捍衛者。

title: There are many amazing underground creatures. The stars of the underground show are earthworms,    16    their role in building soil, their importance to gardeners, and the fascination they afford schoolchildren. Earthworms are giants compared with most other soil    17   . The earthworm's body is made of    18    cylinders, which look like many little rings joined together. They are    19    that chew their way through soil, feeding on plant and animal detritus and on microbes, digesting and thoroughly mixing organic and inorganic components before eliminating it as humus. This    20    breaks complex organic molecules down into simpler forms more suitable for uptake by plants.

subItems.hint:
16. The stars of the underground show are earthworms, because of their role in building soil, their importance to gardeners, and the fascination they afford schoolchildren.
（地下世界的明星是蚯蚓，因為牠們在土壤形成中的角色、對園丁的重要性，以及帶給學童的著迷。）
  • 考點：because of＝因為（後接名詞片語）；三個並列名詞：their role / their importance / the fascination。
  • 其他選項：soon after 不久之後；despite of（錯誤用法，despite 後不加 of）；right after 就在……之後。
撇步
  • 後面接名詞 → because of；接子句才用 because。

17. Earthworms are giants compared with most other soil organisms.
（與大多數其他土壤生物相比，蚯蚓堪稱巨人。）
  • 考點：organisms＝生物體；soil organisms＝土壤生物。
  • 線索：Earthworms（蚯蚓）＋compared with most other soil ___ → 應是同類的「生物」。
  • 其他選項：fossils 化石；fungi 真菌（範圍太窄）；obstacles 障礙。
撇步
  • 蚯蚓是「土壤生物」→ soil organisms。

18. The earthworm's body is made of segmented cylinders, which look like many little rings joined together.
（蚯蚓的身體由分節的圓柱體組成，看起來像許多相連的小環。）
  • 考點：segmented＝分節的（segment 節、片段）。
  • 線索：which look like many little rings joined together（像許多相連的小環）→ 正是「分節」。
  • 其他選項：tormented 受折磨的；cemented 用水泥黏合的；lamented 哀悼的。
撇步
  • 「一節一節」→ segmented（segment 就是「節」）。

19. They are omnivores that chew their way through soil, feeding on plant and animal detritus and on microbes...
（牠們是雜食動物，一路吃穿土壤，以植物與動物的碎屑及微生物為食……）
  • 考點：omnivore＝雜食動物（omni- 全部 + -vore 吃）。
  • 線索：feeding on plant and animal detritus（吃植物與動物碎屑）→ 既吃植物也吃動物＝雜食。
  • 其他選項：erasers 橡皮擦；aviaries 鳥舍；ulcers 潰瘍。
撇步
  • 字根：herbivore 草食、carnivore 肉食、omnivore 雜食。

20. This process breaks complex organic molecules down into simpler forms more suitable for uptake by plants.
（這個過程把複雜的有機分子分解成更適合植物吸收的簡單形式。）
  • 考點：process＝過程；this process 指前一句「消化、混合、排出腐植質」的整個過程。
  • 其他選項：shuttle 穿梭（班車）；liability 責任、負債；hamper 妨礙。
撇步
  • 前文描述一連串動作 → 用 this process 總結。

title:
The National Immigration Agency (NIA) in Taiwan announced that new immigrant mothers who are divorced with children born in Taiwan are allowed to continue staying in Taiwan despite that they lose the custody of their children. The NIA's decision to amend the law is invariably linked with the protection of the children's rights and interests. The NIA restated that Article 31 of the Immigration Act in 2007 was modified to safeguard the rights and interests of foreign spouses after a divorce. The amendment contains enabling them to have the custody of children after a divorce and get divorced with their Taiwanese spouses if they are victims of domestic violence.

In the past, new immigrant mothers who are divorced without the custody of their children are usually compelled to leave the country. Yet, their right to have visitation of their children will still be granted depending on the NIA's evaluation of each case concerning what extent the mothers are involved in bearing and rearing their Taiwanese-born children before they are deported finally. With this adjustment in law, the court will decide whether a mother can obtain the custody of her child/children according to paragraph 4 of Article 31 of the Immigration Act. Once granted, a new immigrant mother in such a circumstance will be authorized to continue dwelling in this country. In the case of a new immigrant mother who has already gone back to her country of origin after a divorce, the NIA claimed that she can still come back to Taiwan with a visitor visa provided that she used to be a legal resident in Taiwan who was the primary caretaker of her child/children or kept in full contact with them.

subItems.title: 21. Which interest group in Taiwan is most likely to welcome this new amendment in law?

options.text: The Chinese Association for Relief and Ensuing Services.

subItems.hint:
→ The Child Welfare League Foundation.
（台灣哪個利益團體最可能歡迎這項修法？→ 兒童福利聯盟。）
  • 定位：第一段「The NIA's decision to amend the law is invariably linked with the protection of the children's rights and interests.」
  • 推論：修法目的在保護兒童權益，最可能歡迎的當然是兒童福利團體。
  • 其他選項：消費者基金會（消費）、荒野保護協會（生態）、中華救助總會（救濟）都與兒童權益無直接關係。
撇步
  • 問「誰會歡迎」→ 找文中受益對象（children）對應的團體。

subItems.title: 22. Which of the following statements is NOT true about the NIA's reform of the Immigration Act?

options.text: It grants the separations between new immigrant mothers and their children in the case of a divorce.
It protects the rights and interests of the children if they are victims of domestic violence.
It sets up a new model of policy-making that takes the welfare of new immigrant families into consideration.
It materializes the ideal of social justice when new immigrant family issues are taken into account.

subItems.hint:
→ It grants the separations between new immigrant mothers and their children in the case of a divorce.
（下列關於 NIA 修法的敘述何者不為真？→ 它允許離婚時新住民母親與子女分離。）
  • 定位：全文主旨是避免母子分離——讓離婚後失去監護權的母親仍能留在台灣，故 (A) 與修法目的相反，是 NOT true。
  • 其他選項：(B) 保護遭家暴的子女權益（第一段）、(C) 形成兼顧新住民家庭福祉的新政策模式、(D) 體現社會正義——都符合文意。
  • 注意否定題：三個為真、一個相反，答案就是相反的那個。
撇步
  • 否定題先抓全文主旨，再看哪個選項「唱反調」。

subItems.title: 23. What is another benefit that a new immigrant mother can gain from this law amendment apart from being allowed to stay in Taiwan after a divorce?

options.text: She can apply for a visitor visa.
She can get a divorce if she wants.
She can choose to leave the country.
She can obtain her child/children's custody.

subItems.hint:
→ She can obtain her child/children's custody.
（除了離婚後可留在台灣，新住民母親還能獲得什麼好處？→ 可取得子女監護權。）
  • 定位：第一段「The amendment contains enabling them to have the custody of children after a divorce...」
  • 其他選項：(A) 觀光簽證是給已返回母國者的例外安排，不是「另一項好處」；(B) 離婚本來就可以；(C) 選擇離境不是好處。
撇步
  • 問「apart from 留在台灣之外」→ 回文找另一個並列的好處：custody。

subItems.title: 24. What is the criterion that a new immigrant mother must fulfill in order to benefit from this amendment in law?

options.text: She needs to stay in Taiwan for at least ten years.
She needs to bear at least two children who were born in Taiwan.
She needs to be a legal immigrant who has stayed continually in Taiwan.
She has to be a lawful resident who has already obtained the citizenship in Taiwan.

subItems.hint:
→ She needs to be a legal immigrant who has stayed continually in Taiwan.
（新住民母親必須符合什麼條件才能適用修法？→ 須為在台持續居留的合法移民。）
  • 定位：第二段「...provided that she used to be a legal resident in Taiwan who was the primary caretaker of her child/children or kept in full contact with them.」
  • 其他選項：(A) 文中未提十年；(B) 未要求兩個子女；(D) 未要求已取得我國國籍。
  • ⚠️ 這題的選項與原文措辭不完全對應（原文重點在「曾是合法居留者」），我依最佳契合選 (C)，請你核對時留意。
撇步
  • 條件題逐一排除「文中沒寫」的數字與資格（十年、兩個小孩、國籍）。

subItems.title: 25. What message does this law amendment send in terms of Taiwan's immigration policy?

options.text: Taiwan implements severe prosecution for illegal new immigrants.
Taiwan enforces many of its improper laws on new immigrants.
Taiwan cares for the needs of new immigrant mothers and their children.
Taiwan serves as a watchdog for new immigrants who have Taiwanese spouses.

subItems.hint:
→ Taiwan cares for the needs of new immigrant mothers and their children.
（這項修法在台灣移民政策上傳達什麼訊息？→ 台灣重視新住民母親與其子女的需求。）
  • 定位：第一段「linked with the protection of the children's rights and interests」＋第二段「the court will decide whether a mother can obtain the custody... Once granted, ... authorized to continue dwelling in this country.」
  • 主旨推論：修法從「强制離境」轉為「保障居留與監護」，展現的是關懷而非嚴厲執法。
  • 其他選項：(A) 嚴厲起訴、(B) 執行不當法律、(D) 扮演監督者——都與全文的保護取向相反。
撇步
  • 問「政策訊息」→ 抓全文的價值取向（保護、關懷），不是單一細節。
